name: STARBASE
desc:
Ramming Speed Update!
- New Energy Ram Weapon!
- New NPC Freighters to Escort or Plunder!
- New Pacific American Gamepass!
- New visual effects! 

Discover the expanse of the galaxy with over 200 ships across a huge procedurally generated solar system with fully explorable planets. 

Inspired by Space Affliction. 

Customize, and command colossal colonies or spawling space stations with a modular building system. 

Coordinate with friends to man massive multicrew spaceships featuring fully detailed interiors ranging from humble shuttles to gargantuan space battle ships and aircraft carriers. 

Master physics-based space combat in space fighter jet dogfights or massive warship battles. 

Graphics level 9-10 recommended. Private server owners can use commands ('@commands' to list) and admin ships in their private servers but do not earn any exp.
